title: Run
description: Full record of one generation: the request plus all four artifacts plus planted/found failure data. Returned by POST /api/runs and GET /api/runs/{id}.

parallelVersion.description: Artifact 2: multithreaded, carries the planted failures, no comments pointing at them.

parallelVersionFixed.description: Corrected version, produced up front alongside everything else — always present, not gated behind any reveal flag.

testHarness.description: Artifact 3: drives both versions and compares them.

report.description: Artifact 4, from the blind analyser. Compare against plantedFailures to see what was found vs. planted — that comparison is computed by the client, not stored here.
